1aca9f8f.text:
The samophlange control console can be used to autmoatically regulate the flow of fuels, gasses, liquids, and related machinery. Once initial configuration has been completed, it should run worry free with minor maintenance.

Brief listing of control console components (from left to right)

I. Main Power Lever

The engaged position enables the samophlange. The control mechanism will not automatically disengage when the lever is put in the off position. This will merely
1aca9f8f.title: Control Console Operating Manual

10378|4fa5b9c3.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|4fa5b9c3.text: Where can I send you today $c?

10378|6bdb24d7.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|6bdb24d7.text: Many are the paths of the Earth Mother.  Wherever you decide to travel, may she watch over you.

10668|19e45338.name: Beaten Corpse
10668|19e45338.text:
The body is that of a female orc warrior.

It is clear that she died in battle, probably against the quilboar in the area.

10668|36aec325.name: Beaten Corpse
10668|36aec325.text:
You turn the body over and see the marks from blades and spells upon the deceased orc--her armor all but destroyed, her hair matted to her face.

Based on Mankrik's description of her, there is no doubt in your mind that this was his wife.

He will be upset by the news, but you are sure he should know the truth.

10880|dc8290dc.name: Warcaller Gorlach
10880|dc8290dc.text: Greetings and salutations, hero!  I have the latest news from both continents and points beyond for your consideration.

11833|eb2e4319.name: Rahauro
11833|eb2e4319.text:
Well met, $c. You may speak to me unless you have direct business with my mistress Magatha.

I deal with most of her tasks for her so she can concentrate on more important matters. Perhaps there are some things we could discuss before you seek audience with her?

11860|ae16ea2b.name: Maggran Earthbinder
11860|ae16ea2b.text: I am afraid that I am no longer gentle or humble. Age and countless battles have hardened my skin and soul. Perhaps that is why Cairne assigned me to Sun Rock Retreat... the gentle winds and warm sun does ease the pain.

11861|2ff59fb5.name: Mor'rogal
11861|2ff59fb5.text:
Stonetalon Mountain has many perilous caves through out this region.  Exploring these caves can hold many adventures for those willing to risk life for glory.

$C, perhaps you seek riches that only following your heart and soul can garnish.

11869|49ff395c.name: Ansekhwa
11869|49ff395c.text: I would be honored to train you in the use of the weapons that I have mastered should you have the ability to learn within you.

16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2121|bf7b697c.name: Shadow Priest Allister
2121|bf7b697c.text: Information... With our scouts and agents, we control the flow of information in Lordaeron. Scourge movements, their holdings, all underneath our watchful eyes...

2215|dc484bb4.name: High Executor Darthalia
2215|dc484bb4.text: In order to serve the Dark Lady and Varimathras we need to advance the front on the Human Infestation.

2216|8e0e34da.name: Apothecary Lydon
2216|8e0e34da.text: We are but so close to developing the New Plague that our Dark Lady desires with such fervor.

2226|dd7de3ae.name: Karos Razok
2226|dd7de3ae.text: Greetings.  Our bats are well trained and fed.  You'll not find faster.

2389|c5ceacbe.name: Zarise
2389|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2391|5dffcf15.name: Serge Hinott
2391|5dffcf15.text: Another interruption. How am I supposed to get any work done like this? Don't answer that; do I look as if I care what you have to say? Why don't you go bother Mr. High-And-Mighty instead?

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

3084|a93675fd.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|a93675fd.text: Ah, you seek the wisdom of Ansekhwa.  Look for him on the lower rise at Thunder Bluff Weapons.

3296|bb16f568.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|bb16f568.text: You want Zamja at Borstan's Firepit on the upper level of The Drag.  Go up the stairs on the left as you enter The Drag from the Valley of Strength.

3309|2f8d506f.name: Karus
3309|2f8d506f.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

3309|ae78a458.name: Karus
3309|ae78a458.text: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3328|0402cd55.name: Ormok
3328|0402cd55.text: The Shattered Hand will see the Horde to their former glory, unhindered by the timidness of the Warchief.

3328|0e004941.name: Ormok
3328|0e004941.text: The Venture Company based around Windshear Crag in Stonetalon keeps their supplies in locked boxes.

3368|5a0b913d.name: Borstan
3368|5a0b913d.text: I have the finest meats in Orgrimmar.

3373|6043e59b.name: Arnok
3373|6043e59b.text: I am an orc of medicine, $r. If you have come here to learn, I shall do my best to teach.

3387|da8a5dad.name: Jorn Skyseer
3387|da8a5dad.text: Although we call this land the Barrens, to one who knows where to look this place teems with life.

3389|5612724d.name: Regthar Deathgate
3389|5612724d.text: We have our duties, $c.  Duties to the Horde.

3391|8f749700.name: Gazlowe
3391|8f749700.text: Thrall paid me and my boys well for helping out with the construction of Orgrimmar, so I decided to set up a port here. We do most of our business through Booty Bay and Baron Revilgaz.

3401|8830368a.name: Shenthul
3401|8830368a.text:
The Shattered Hand's influence dominates these lands. We are the veil which covers Kalimdor: The protectorates, the police, the judges, the jury, and ultimately, the executioners. We see all, we know all.

You have grown much in the time which you have spent in service of the Hand, $N. The time has come to send you into the field.

Are you prepared to undertake your next mission?

3402|6cb63392.name: Zando'zan
3402|6cb63392.text: Zando'zan of the Shattered Hand. How can Zando'zan help you? He can't! He won't!

3430|0e16a4d2.name: Mangletooth
3430|0e16a4d2.text:
You! $R! Come here. <snort>

Time is short, and my end <snort> is near. Mangletooth shall win; you will see. <snort>

My capture can still aid <snort> my people. The Razormane tribe is more powerful than the Bristlebacks!

The Horde looks to find out who leads the raids on their people. You <snort> shall aid Mangletooth in return for the information only I know. Mangletooth can help you! <snort> But you must help Mangletooth.

3432|c1a3099b.name: Mankrik
3432|c1a3099b.text:
I came to the Crossroads from the south seeking help, $c, but I find only cowards who turn their backs on me--even the mighty Thork insults me so. He is a good leader, but his dismissal of my plea causes me greater anger.

He claims my rage makes me hasty--that it clouds my judgement--but I will not rest until I have vengeance!

3433|4ec00f6f.name: Tatternack Steelforge
3433|4ec00f6f.text:
The Warchief has instructed me to study all kinds of weapons and armor. He has sent me here to the hub of both the tauren and orc cultures in the Barrens to meet as many travelers as possible, and to learn about the cultures of the Barrens.

He feels there's something to be learned from even the most pathetic of cultures... like the quilboar or centaur.

3442|6812c5a7.name: Sputtervalve
3442|6812c5a7.text:
Interesting, interesting... I know of a druid that lives atop the hill above the Wailing Caverns, $N. She might be able to tell you more about this shard you have found.

Now, I must get back to work!

3442|c0ad1190.name: Sputtervalve
3442|c0ad1190.text: Lots to do, lots to do! The Union's given us deadlines and they're not the sort you want to miss!

3446|36457281.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
3446|36457281.text:
Yes yes yes!  You're just the $r I'm looking for!

Sit!  We have much to discuss!!

3448|dcea3712.name: Tonga Runetotem
3448|dcea3712.text: The times we live in are as fickle as the shifting winds, $c.  It is important to remember what is true and lasting in this world, and to preserve that.  Everything else is a waste.

3483|aa3c8600.name: Jahan Hawkwing
3483|aa3c8600.text: The Barrens, with its hot sun and hostile denizens, is the perfect place to test your strength and fortitude.

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

3934|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Boorand Plainswind
3934|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

4049|65e1afb2.name: Seereth Stonebreak
4049|65e1afb2.text: The spirit of Stonetalon weeps.  It weeps from its mountain peaks, to its rivers, to its severed, dying trees.

4312|c5ceacbe.name: Tharm
4312|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

4552|0c543544.name: Eunice Burch
4552|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

5624|41ebb2bb.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|41ebb2bb.text: Eunice Burch sell leftover parts.  You find her in Trade Quarter.

5769|c9ae2675.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
5769|c9ae2675.text: The earth keeps many secrets, $c; it is our duty to ensure that those that must remain a secret for the good of all stays as such.

5784|3fc6ad9d.name: Waldor
5784|3fc6ad9d.text: The caverns below us are a source of strange and wondrous hides, but you must take care if you venture into their depths, $N. Remember that your own skin is far more valuable.

6566|0deb5cc3.name: Estelle Gendry
6566|0deb5cc3.text: With the sanction of Lord Varimathras, the Deathstalkers' numbers grow. More blades to strike at our enemies when they least expect it.

6929|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Gryshka
6929|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

7161|4df495bf.name: Wrenix the Wretched
7161|4df495bf.text: Pirates. I hate them. I don't just hate them; I despise them with every fiber of my being. What with all the 'ARRRRR!' and 'YARRR!' and those awful birds they keep as pets - how could anyone stand pirates, let alone be a pirate?

7233|0c7ac5e1.name: Taskmaster Fizzule
7233|0c7ac5e1.text:
Something plagues this tower. I've fallen ill and the other Venture Co. employees that work near or in the tower have also become sick.

Just last week, two of our patrollers died, only to instantly come back to life as mindless drones!

The lifeforce is draining from my body. I can feel myself losing control. Urges taking over... Bad urges... *Fizzule slaps himself in the face* Not yet... Listen... Mine is a position of power. This position privies me to some sensitive information.

7731|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Jayka
7731|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

1058-accept.name: Witch Doctor Jin'Zil
1058-accept.text:
So excited I am!

Three little cages for three little elves! But what shall we do with our lovely tree-hugging friends? Why, let's give them a taste of... what do they call it... forest magic!

I'll need a good mess of Stonetalon sap. From those horrid felines, bring me some twilight whiskers. This calls for plenty of courser eyes, of course -- can never have enough eyes. Oh, and lest we forget, a precious scale from a fey dragon.

Hurry to Stonetalon Peak, $N, so I can brew some forest magic!
1058-accept.title: Jin'Zil's Forest Magic

1061-complete.name: Seereth Stonebreak
1061-complete.text: Ah, a $c.  Very good.  We will need your skills to deal with these plunderers!
1061-complete.title: The Spirits of Stonetalon

1062-accept.name: Seereth Stonebreak
1062-accept.text:
The goblin-run Venture Company moved into the Stonetalon Mountains, chopping down trees and burning huge stretches of forest.  The spirits of this place are nearly blind with pain and rage.  We must stop the Venture Company!

Head northwest, beyond the Greatwood Vale and into the Windshear Crag.  You will find the goblins and their servants at work -- show them the Horde will not allow the exploitation of Stonetalon.  Show them in the language they best understand...

Violence.
1062-accept.title: Goblin Invaders

1062-complete.name: Seereth Stonebreak
1062-complete.text:
Bravely done, $N.

We may ultimately need the wisdom of tauren elders to calm the spirits of Stonetalon, but...

Ridding the Venture Company of its personnel is a good first move against them.
1062-complete.title: Goblin Invaders

1063-accept.name: Seereth Stonebreak
1063-accept.text:
To truly tend the spirits of Stonetalon we must consult the tauren elders.

I do not know many of their leaders' names, but I do know of one: Magatha.  I have heard that she is very old, and she knows much.  If anyone can marshal spiritual aid from the tauren, it is she.

Magatha resides in the tauren capital of Thunder Bluff, on Elder Rise -- the city's northeastern bluff.  Speak with Magatha, and tell her of the peril of Stonetalon Mountains.
1063-accept.title: The Elder Crone

1063-complete.name: Magatha Grimtotem
1063-complete.text: I bid you greetings.  You are here seeking counsel?
1063-complete.title: The Elder Crone

1068-accept.name: Seereth Stonebreak
1068-accept.text:
There is a relation to the spiritual magic of shamans and the natural magic of druids.  This is why we shamans can hear the plea of the spirits of Stonetalon.  Many of their whisperings are lost to me, but one message, one vision, is clear...

I saw a vision of two man-shaped machines in Windshear Crag, northwest of Greatwood Vale, felling trees with impossible speed.  These metal beasts must be stopped!

In my vision, the machines were marked with strange symbols:

XT:4 and XT:9.
1068-accept.title: Shredding Machines

1068-complete.name: Seereth Stonebreak
1068-complete.text:
The destruction of the machines XT:4 and XT:9 have soothed many of the spirits of Stonetalon, $N.  With their loss, let us hope the Venture Company will remove itself from these mountains.

For if they do not, then I fear the atrocities this place has suffered will pale to what lies ahead.
1068-complete.title: Shredding Machines

1069-complete.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
1069-complete.text:
You got them!  Thank you!

I'll have these sent to Dizzywig and get them shipped to Booty Bay.  I can already taste the profits!

Here is your cut, $N.  I couldn't have made this deal without you.
1069-complete.title: Deepmoss Spider Eggs

1069-progress.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
1069-progress.text: Did you get the eggs, $N?  I already made a shipping deal with Wharfmaster Dizzywig!
1069-progress.title: Deepmoss Spider Eggs

1087-accept.name: Braelyn Firehand
1087-accept.text:
You cannot imagine the hatred I possess for this wretched land. The ilk of Cenarius and the kaldorei druids at the peak employ their pathetic powers to stifle the flow of magic, even so far south of their pathetic holdings... their beloved forests.

Would that I could return to Jaedenar and exult in the flow of magic, but my master will not allow me to return until my work is done.

I have no doubt you love the night elves and their allies as little as I. Aid me, and both our ends might be satisfied.
1087-accept.title: Cenarius' Legacy

1087-complete.name: Braelyn Firehand
1087-complete.text:
Already I can feel it... yes... power so sweet... the rushing flood. The kaldorei are foolish to spurn the gifts of this world, to reject the coursing of magic as it flows singing through your veins.

What a pale mockery life is without its burning embrace!
1087-complete.title: Cenarius' Legacy

1088-accept.name: Braelyn Firehand
1088-accept.text:
They thought that they could halt the flow of magic. They were mistaken. They thought that they could hide Ordanus, but I will have his head!

Magic grants me true sight. Yes... there he is. A crossroads... At the top of a great tree in Ashenvale Forest. A name... Raynewood. One of the eldest sons of the forest god. They spirited him away from the peak before I could find him, but his time runs short.

Bring it to me and I will share with you a mighty gift.
1088-accept.title: Ordanus

1090-complete.name: Piznik
1090-complete.text:
Thanks, $N. It was looking a little dicey there for a second and we've probably drawn far too much attention to ourselves.

The important part is that we have the ore sample, though, and we should get it to Ziz as soon as possible.
1090-complete.title: Gerenzo's Orders

1092-accept.name: Piznik
1092-accept.text:
I guess I'd better think about getting out of here, also. It won't take long for word of what happened here to spread to the higher ups, and I'm sure they wouldn't take too kindly to meeting me again.

I'll sneak out and meet with Ziz. Hopefully, he'll be able to find me a new job!

I'll try and clean up this mess a little, but you should take the ore sample to Ziz right away. He told me that he'd set up camp somewhere on the western side of Windshear Crag. Good luck.
1092-accept.title: Gerenzo's Orders

1092-complete.name: Ziz Fizziks
1092-complete.text:
Ahhh, I knew that I did the right thing by telling Piznik to stay behind. I'm sure the engineers in Undermine will be most interested to look at this...

Of course I'll want to keep a little piece for myself, but what they don't know won't hurt them, yes?
1092-complete.title: Gerenzo's Orders

1092-progress.name: Ziz Fizziks
1092-progress.text: Something I can help you with?
1092-progress.title: Gerenzo's Orders

1093-accept.name: Ziz Fizziks
1093-accept.text:
Terrible what the Venture Company has done here, eh? What were they thinking? Goblin company hiring a gnome!

Lucky for me, Sputtervalve knows a genius when he sees one. Hired me just after I'd been kicked out!

Tells me they built some enormous woodcutting machine, and Sput' wants me to steal the plans for him. Unfortunately, Gerenzo--bloody gnome--wants me dead on sight... maybe you could steal the plans for me? You should be able to find them on one of their operators.
1093-accept.title: Super Reaper 6000

1093-complete.name: Ziz Fizziks
1093-complete.text:
Hey, is that what I think it is? Great!

Now, let's see. Ugh... how am I supposed to understand this stuff... can't figure out the way gnomes think. Lemme tell you, I'm surprised they could build the wheel, let alone those flying machines they like so much.
1093-complete.title: Super Reaper 6000

1093-progress.name: Ziz Fizziks
1093-progress.text: Did you find those plans? I'm eager to impress the new boss. Hopefully, once he's convinced of my loyalty--well, as much as he can be convinced... goblin's honor, you know?--he'll feel comfortable making use of my rather impressive genius.
1093-progress.title: Super Reaper 6000

1094-accept.name: Ziz Fizziks
1094-accept.text:
This envelope has all the information I was able to snatch as they booted me out the door... Venture Company internal documents, some manuals, technical things... Oh, and of course the Super Reaper 6000 blueprints.

Sputtervalve has taken up residence at Ratchet in the Barrens. Shouldn't have much trouble finding him, he's a little green fellow.
1094-accept.title: Further Instructions

1094-complete.name: Sputtervalve
1094-complete.text:
Fizziks, eh? Can't say I trust him, but this information seems good enough. What I wouldn't give to have the Venture Company out of my hair.

They do come up with some good machines though... I can't deny that we've benefited from using some of the improvements they've devised.
1094-complete.title: Further Instructions

1094-progress.name: Sputtervalve
1094-progress.text: Hello there! How can I help you?
1094-progress.title: Further Instructions

1095-accept.name: Sputtervalve
1095-accept.text:
The matter of this gnome that has been hired by the Venture Company has caused a bit of a stir in Undermine. The trade princes do not approve of Razdunk's consorting with this Gerenzo.

Riddlevox has asked me to take care of the problem, and I'm sure he was instructed to do so by one or more of the trade princes. Of course, the Director didn't tell me that. Let's just say I have a hunch.

Whatever the case, Gerenzo must be removed, and it would be a fitting test to have Fizziks take care of him.
1095-accept.title: Further Instructions

1095-complete.name: Ziz Fizziks
1095-complete.text:
Eliminate Gerenzo? Now there is a prospect that I have no objections to.

Gnomes are bad enough as it is, but what I learned about Gerenzo only makes it worse. Apparently, he was one of the head engineers in Gnomeregan, where he was working on their secret project--we could never infiltrate Dun Morogh well enough to find out specific details. It was a failure. Our reports say that whatever it was literally exploded in their faces.
1095-complete.title: Further Instructions

1096-accept.name: Ziz Fizziks
1096-accept.text:
I met Gerenzo once, but let me tell you, he's not easy on the eyes. His flesh looks like it's rotting away, and he's grafted metal and gears onto his body, replaced some of his limbs with mechanical ones.

Northeast of here, far above Cragpool Lake, up near the water wheel is where Gerenzo watches over the entire site. There's no way I could fight my way up there, not to mention take on Gerenzo... But you look like you might be able to make it.

If you kill him for me, I'll make it worth your while!
1096-accept.title: Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle

1096-complete.name: Ziz Fizziks
1096-complete.text:
Look at that thing... it'd take a gnome to come up with something like that. I can't understand why you'd cut off an arm, and replace it with that, when you could just keep both arms and add a third!

Gnomes, I tell you...

At least Gerenzo's out of commission. Hopefully that'll be enough proof, and Sputtervalve will assign me to one of the Tinkers' Union workshops in Gadgetzan or maybe even Undermine.
1096-complete.title: Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle

1096-progress.name: Ziz Fizziks
1096-progress.text: Sputtervalve will want some sort of proof that Gerenzo's dead. I think his mechanical arm will probably do.
1096-progress.title: Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle

1130-accept.name: Jorn Skyseer
1130-accept.text:
$N, Melor Stonehoof has heard of your deeds, and has set a path before you.

If you wish to take it, then go to Thunder Bluff and speak with Melor.  You will find him on Hunter's Rise.
1130-accept.title: Melor Sends Word

1130-complete.name: Melor Stonehoof
1130-complete.text:
So, $N, you have come.  Now, are you prepared to journey through distant lands?

If so, young $c, then listen on...
1130-complete.title: Melor Sends Word

1131-accept.name: Melor Stonehoof
1131-accept.text:
At times we hunt for food.  At times we hunt for honor.  And at times we hunt to earn the Earthmother's teachings.

But the hunt I now set upon you is none of these things.  It is to slay a creature outside the Earthmother's blessing.

The hyena Steelsnap roams the Thousand Needles, south of the Barrens.  He is a tyrant, attracting other hyenas to him and spreading fear and bloodshed among more peaceful beasts.

Find Steelsnap, $N.  Find him, and defeat him.
1131-accept.title: Steelsnap

1195-accept.name: Zangen Stonehoof
1195-accept.text:
The Galak centaur in the Thousand Needles are protecting an artifact from the time of the centaurs' creation.

We would like to retrieve it, but we require a phial of water from one of the night elves' moonwells.

To collect the water, you will first need to obtain one of the phials carried by the dryads near the Raynewood Retreat in the heart of Ashenvale Forest. There is a moonwell near the western bank of the Falfarren River, south of the main road, where you can fill the phial.
1195-accept.title: The Sacred Flame

1221-accept.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
1221-accept.text:
Blueleaf tubers are a delicacy around the world!  But they're rare, very rare.  The only place to find them is here in the Barrens, deep in the earth, in Razorfen Kraul.

And even then, they're impossible to find unless you know just where to look!  That's why I've trained these snufflenose gophers to find them for me.  They have great noses and can smell a tuber from fifty paces away.

It won't be easy, but if you get me some tubers I'll pay you handsomely.
1221-accept.title: Blueleaf Tubers

1483-complete.name: Ziz Fizziks
1483-complete.text:
I thought those Venture Company higher-ups were slave drivers, but then I met Sputtervalve, the cruelest of them all!

Ha! Though it's better than being out of a job, I suppose... Or worse, working with that Gerenzo. If you're here to help, I've got something for you to do.
1483-complete.title: Ziz Fizziks

1486-accept.name: Dots
1486-accept.text:
As Naralex descended deeper into his nightmare, a strange breed of beasts arose from beneath the Barrens into the Wailing Caverns.

These deviate creatures have strange, otherworldly properties. While evil in nature, it is my opinion that some good can come from their existence here in Kalimdor. I believe their hides will be of particular use in the ways of leatherworking.

If you feel up to the task, venture into the caves below and retrieve some deviate hides.
1486-accept.title: Deviate Hides

1486-complete.name: Nalpak
1486-complete.text:
Your efforts shall not go unnoticed in gathering these hides, $N.

Thank you for your dedication.
1486-complete.title: Deviate Hides

1486-progress.name: Nalpak
1486-progress.text: I am very interested in examining the hides from the deviate creatures who have infested these caves. Have you had any luck in collecting some, $c?
1486-progress.title: Deviate Hides

1487-accept.name: Dots
1487-accept.text:
Naralex had a noble goal.

Our great leader aspired to enter the Emerald Dream and help regrow these harsh lands back into the lush forest it once was. But something went terribly wrong.

Naralex's dream turned into a nightmare and corrupt creatures began to inhabit the caverns.

While some Disciples of Naralex seek to awake our master, my concern is with ridding these caves of the evil beasts.

Brave the caverns, $N, and eradicate the deviate spawn.
1487-accept.title: Deviate Eradication

1487-complete.name: Ebru
1487-complete.text:
As a Disciple of Naralex, I commend your bravery, $N.

Your aid in ridding the caverns is the first step in our long plight to see the Barrens restored.

Thank you and may you prosper.
1487-complete.title: Deviate Eradication

1491-complete.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
1491-complete.text:
Great, you got it!  I can't wait to try it out.  This is going to make me a fortune, I just know it!

Thank you, $N.  Take this, and after I'm rich I'll send you more, I promise!
1491-complete.title: Smart Drinks

1998-complete.name: Mennet Carkad
1998-complete.text: You've done well, $N. It occurs to me that you have performed many services for the Deathstalkers, proving your worth, and that perhaps it is time that we furthered your training in the shadow arts.
1998-complete.title: Fenwick Thatros

1998-progress.name: Mennet Carkad
1998-progress.text: I have placed the utmost faith in you to perform this service for Lord Varimathras.
1998-progress.title: Fenwick Thatros

1999-accept.name: Mennet Carkad
1999-accept.text:
The wizards of the Kirin Tor at Ambermill have stored away important documents pertaining to the current state of Dalaran. This we know from the admissions of one of our prisoners. Lord Varimathras has placed the duty of recovering them in the hands of the Deathstalkers.

This task falls to you, $N. You will need some equipment, however, and the knowledge of lockpicking. Speak with Estelle Gendry, our outfitter, and ask her for a set of tools before you set out.
1999-accept.title: Tools of the Trade

235-accept.name: Warcaller Gorlach
235-accept.text:
Attention, young adventurers!  The wilds of Ashenvale await you!

The Horde has established a strong presence in the lands north of the Barrens.  Our two outposts - Splintertree Post and the Zoram Strand Outpost - strive to bring glory to the Horde!  Those who would prove themselves should seek out guidance there.  Of note: Senani Thunderheart in Splintertree Post, directly north of the Barrens, seeks adventurers willing to take part in a great hunt of Ashenvale!
235-accept.title: The Ashenvale Hunt

2381-complete.name: Wrenix the Wretched
2381-complete.text:
Incredible! Improbable! Simply amazing! You've got talent, $N. Either that or you're the luckiest man alive!

Here's your cut of the action. I'm sure you would make better use of this stuff than I could.
2381-complete.title: Plundering the Plunderers

2381-progress.name: Wrenix the Wretched
2381-progress.text: Well, at least you still have all of your body parts. Did you find the treasure?
2381-progress.title: Plundering the Plunderers

2458-accept.name: Shenthul
2458-accept.text:
The Venture Company... Perhaps you have heard of them?

For one year we have worked on planting an agent deep within their ranks. Through much hard work and careful planning, we succeeded.

Recently we received word that the Venture Co. are planning something on a grand scale. Go north of the Sludge Fen to the Venture Co. tower and contact our undercover agent, Taskmaster Fizzule.

When you find the tower, use this flare gun, then approach Fizzule and show him the salute of the Shattered Hand.
2458-accept.title: Deep Cover

2458-complete.name: Taskmaster Fizzule
2458-complete.text:
It's good to see another agent of the Shattered Hand in these parts, however, the flare may have been a little too much!

Next time you need to speak with me, blow into this whistle twice and I'll know you are an ally.
2458-complete.title: Deep Cover

2460-accept.name: Shenthul
2460-accept.text:
As a $c of the Shattered Hand, it is imperative that you learn the Shattered Salute. It is the only way to truly identify another member of the Hand.

Watch, learn, repeat.
2460-accept.title: The Shattered Salute

2460-complete.name: Shenthul
2460-complete.text: Well done, $N. You are now ready to proceed.
2460-complete.title: The Shattered Salute

2478-accept.name: Taskmaster Fizzule
2478-accept.text:
You will need to steal the tower key from Foreman Silixiz, $N. Once you've got the key in your possession, hold on to it - I may need it later.

Remember, the poison has weakened everything in this tower. Use your abilities to bring chaos and destruction to its inhabitants. Slay them all -- show no mercy!

Once everything inside lays in a bloodied heap, pick Gallywix's lockbox and steal the cache of Zanzil's mixture held inside. Take both the head of Gallywix and the mixture to Shenthul in Orgrimmar.
2478-accept.title: Mission: Possible But Not Probable

2478-complete.name: Shenthul
2478-complete.text:
Poor Fizzule, he was a good agent -- one of our best. Alas, it is the price we pay, $N. Being a field agent of the Shattered Hand is dangerous work.

You have performed your duty well, $c. It would be a shame if you did not live to serve us again.
2478-complete.title: Mission: Possible But Not Probable

2479-accept.name: Shenthul
2479-accept.text:
Take a sample of the mixture to Serge Hinott in Tarren Mill.

If anyone can cure you, it's Serge. Live long enough and Serge will show you the ways of poison creation and use.
2479-accept.title: Hinott's Assistance

2479-complete.name: Serge Hinott
2479-complete.text: You look deliciously pale, $c. And what is that foul aroma you are giving off? I must know!
2479-complete.title: Hinott's Assistance

2480-accept.name: Serge Hinott
2480-accept.text:
I have never seen such wondrous results from a poison! Zanzil you say? Never heard of him, however, I must commend him on the creation of this concoction.

So, I am to cure you of this and then teach you how to make use of the poison?

Give me a few moments to examine the toxin, $N.
2480-accept.title: Hinott's Assistance

2480-complete.name: Serge Hinott
2480-complete.text: The cure is ready! Drink this anti-toxin and the creeping madness will stop, however, I will not be able to do anything about the smell.
2480-complete.title: Hinott's Assistance

3369-accept.name: Falla Sagewind
3369-accept.text:
This shard holds great secrets; it is the pure essence of the Emerald Dream. However, what I see in this shard is not a dream; one would call this sort of a vision a nightmare.

I do not wish to alarm you, $N, but I think it is best if you deliver this shard into the hands of a wise druid as soon as you can.

Hamuul Runetotem on Elder Rise is who you need to find. Head to Thunder Bluff. I cannot say more.
3369-accept.title: In Nightmares

3369-complete.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
3369-complete.text:
Falla sent you to me? Well now, let's see that shard that you say she was so hesitant to talk about...

<Hamuul peers into the shard>

Oh... I didn't... Well.

$N, thank you for delivering this to me. It isn't wise to speak of things such as this, though, I advise you. These are matters that you should not concern yourself with.

Let's just say that things in the Emerald Dream are not as we thought...

Perhaps in the future, our paths may cross again.
3369-complete.title: In Nightmares

3369-progress.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
3369-progress.text: May I help you with something?
3369-progress.title: In Nightmares

480-accept.name: Shadow Priest Allister
480-accept.text:
An archmage of great power is overseeing the reactivation of the ley energy node. With the progress they have made, our only hope of stopping them is by killing him. It will be difficult, he is no doubt protected by many other mages and warders.

You must go, and you must dispatch him quickly. When he is dead, retrieve his staff for me. Go now.
480-accept.title: The Weaver

494-accept.name: Deathstalker Lesh
494-accept.text:
Be silent and pay attention, $c.

I was sent to this position in order to survey the town of Hillsbrad.  My mission is one of reconnaissance.  It is imperative that you send word to High Executor Darthalia in Tarren Mill at once.  Let her know that I, Deathstalker Lesh, send the following message:

"The raven's cry from the west doth beckon."

Follow the road to the east and pay close attention to the signs.  Now, hurry!  Off you go to Tarren Mill, and with urgency I might add!
494-accept.title: Time To Strike

494-complete.name: High Executor Darthalia
494-complete.text:
The raven's cry from the west doth beckon?

Superb news!  Hillsbrad is ripe for attack.  We can carry out our plan of destruction now.  Varimathras will be pleased.
494-complete.title: Time To Strike

496-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
496-accept.text:
Ah, another wretched day in Tarren Mill.  All of this clean air puts me in such a foul mood, $N.

The sooner we can plague the humans here, the better.  I've been conducting intense studies on possible killing agents to use in my concoctions but I haven't the time to collect them all.

If you want to make yourself of use, procure the following items for me:  10 Gray Bear Tongues and the very rare and hard to find, Creeper Ichor.  You'll find both bears and creepers just outside of Tarren Mill.
496-accept.title: Elixir of Suffering

498-accept.name: Krusk
498-accept.text:
Me and some other warriors were sent by the Warchief to retrieve an object from Durnholde and to investigate this so-called Syndicate.

We went to Durnholde to take a look around, but we were taken by surprise by a large number of the humans. We fought bravely, but their sheer numbers were enough to defeat us. They took a few of us captive, but I was able to escape.

Durnholde is just southeast of here, across the river. Drull and Tog'thar are being held there, you must go and rescue them.
498-accept.title: The Rescue

527-accept.name: High Executor Darthalia
527-accept.text:
Stand at attention while addressing me, $c.

I am under direct command of Varimathras.  We are to quell the human infestation until our apothecaries can develop the new plague.

Our information leads us to believe that the town of Hillsbrad is vulnerable to attack.  Your first assignment is aimed at disrupting their food supply and infrastructure.

Travel west.  Raid the northernmost farms of Hillsbrad Fields.  Make sure that the landowners, Farmer Ray and Farmer Getz, are executed as well.
527-accept.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

5723-complete.name: Rahauro
5723-complete.text:
I am glad to see you took Magatha's task seriously. Thank you, $N. I'm sure the troggs will have a harder time coming to the surface with their numbers so greatly reduced.

Perhaps in the future we can take time to figure out where such creatures came from, and what they really want.
5723-complete.title: Testing an Enemy's Strength

5724-complete.name: Rahauro
5724-complete.text:
Excellent, $N. Thank you.

Magatha told me that if you were successful in finding her clansman that you be given this. Please, take it in thanks.
5724-complete.title: Returning the Lost Satchel

5724-progress.name: Rahauro
5724-progress.text: Were you able to find anything, $N? Any clues as to why one of her clansman had to die needlessly would be helpful.
5724-progress.title: Returning the Lost Satchel

5881-accept.name: Maggran Earthbinder
5881-accept.text:
The Horde does well keeping our troops fresh... since the Great War we have been prosperous here in Kalimdor.

I need you to do me a favor, I have a lad by the name of Grish Longrunner protecting the Great Lift in the southern barrens. Give him this letter; the letter will let him know that I have a reserve warrior coming to relieve him of duty so that he can visit his family. He requested this sometime ago and he would be happy to hear the news.
5881-accept.title: Calling in the Reserves

6282-accept.name: Maggran Earthbinder
6282-accept.text:
Tauren take pride as the protectors of these lands. Undoubtedly you can guess why I am alarmed with the number of harpies that dwell here in Stonetalon.

The Bloodfuries are the source of the increasing number of harpies in Kalimdor; they encroach upon all likes of life preventing the innocent from leaving their boundaries.

I need you to cull the harpies, $N!
6282-accept.title: Harpies Threaten

6282-complete.name: Maggran Earthbinder
6282-complete.text: This is most excellent news! Tell me again how you cast fear into the cold hearts of those vile harpies. The Bloodfuries have been dealt a serious blow!
6282-complete.title: Harpies Threaten

6283-accept.name: Maggran Earthbinder
6283-accept.text:
Limiting the number of Bloodfury Harpies will not be enough. The only true cure for their disease would be to slay their leader, Bloodfury Ripper!

She is all but a queen to those filthy creatures. Slay her and their numbers will surely diminish.

Go back into the Charred Vale and you will find her along the western hills. She will not be easy to vanquish, but the reward will be great.
6283-accept.title: Bloodfury Bloodline

6283-complete.name: Maggran Earthbinder
6283-complete.text:
Already I feel the anger leave me. What will I do with my time? Knowing evil moves near my land kept my thoughts moving, though now they are silent. Perhaps this is a good thing... maybe now I can focus on the good, as all Tauren should.

Please accept this as a reward for your troubles.
6283-complete.title: Bloodfury Bloodline

6283-progress.name: Maggran Earthbinder
6283-progress.text:
Bloodfury Ripper is a nasty creature! You will have success finding her along the western hill line in the Charred Vale.

The bloodfuries will be helpless with out... surely we can vanquish them forever!
6283-progress.title: Bloodfury Bloodline

6284-accept.name: Unknown
6284-accept.text:
Warning: Proceed into Sishir Canyon west of here at your own risk.

Besseleth and her eight-legged children of the forest have claimed this canyon as their webbed lair.

Maggran Earthbinder in Sun Rock Retreat has placed a bounty on Besseleth. Slay her and bring proof of your killing to Maggran; there you will receive your reward for disposing this eight-legged menace.
6284-accept.title: Arachnophobia

6284-complete.name: Maggran Earthbinder
6284-complete.text:
Good hunting, $N! Besseleth is an old predator in these parts... I will miss her not. Take this reward as a token for being the forest champion.

<Maggran rubs the wound caused by Besseleth.>

Perhaps now many more will travel to Sun Rock Retreat without fearing what lurks in the dark.
6284-complete.title: Arachnophobia

6284-progress.name: Maggran Earthbinder
6284-progress.text: Besseleth is a ruthless predator... I fear for those that travel Webwinder Path at night. It's then that she and her children prey upon innocent travelers. I myself fell prey to her two-foot fang of death, but luckily I was able to fend her off and get to safety. I would give anything to see that monster destroyed.
6284-progress.title: Arachnophobia

6301-accept.name: Tammra Windfield
6301-accept.text:
Industrial greed and continuous war have wrecked the lands of Stonetalon. Only the blessings of the Earthmother can cure such injury.

$N, I will require you to seek a special seed, the Gaea seed. They are only found here in Stonetalon Mountain, north of Sun Rock Retreat at Mirkfallon Lake, near the water's edge.

Once you bring me the seeds I will imbue them with shamanistic power to speed their growth.
6301-accept.title: Cycle of Rebirth

6301-complete.name: Tammra Windfield
6301-complete.text:
Ah, $N, you have the Gaea seeds. Watch and see how the blessing of the Earthmother can cause even these small kernels of life to bloom and flourish.

<Tammra begins to chant.>
6301-complete.title: Cycle of Rebirth

6301-progress.name: Tammra Windfield
6301-progress.text: The continuous destruction caused by war and those that seek a profit from lumber pains me deeply. To aid the cycle of rebirth and replenish the lands, I need Gaea seeds. Do you have them, $c?
6301-progress.title: Cycle of Rebirth

6381-accept.name: Tammra Windfield
6381-accept.text:
As you have seen, $c, though the land is in pain, the cycle of life is a powerful thing. Now we must do our part help it along. You must plant these seeds at the center of the destruction, to the west, in the Charred Vale. Beware, for harpies and angry fire elementals still plague the scarred land.

$N, take these enchanted Gaea seeds and plant them in fertile mounds of soil. The cycle of life must go on!
6381-accept.title: New Life

6381-complete.name: Tammra Windfield
6381-complete.text:
This is great victory for the land. In time, other things will come to pass: the Venture Co. will pack up their buzz saws and axes, the angry fire spirits will calm, and the harpies will be pushed out by the land.

Only then $N, will Stonetalon be truly at peace.

You have done well $c; take one of these items as thanks for the new life you have created here today.
6381-complete.title: New Life

6381-progress.name: Tammra Windfield
6381-progress.text:
These seeds you plant are strong, resisting corruption, and making a foothold for other life. They will grow and grow, first preventing corruption and healing the scarred land, and then one day, restoring Stonetalon to a lush forest, once again.

Have you planted all of the Gaea seeds?
6381-progress.title: New Life

6393-accept.name: Tsunaman
6393-accept.text:
The Tribunal of the Tides has sent me to wage war on the fire elementals here in Stonetalon Mountain. Neptulon the Tidehunter, Lord of all water elementals, has taken a personal interest in seeing our fiery cousins extinguished.

$N, you can help me gain favor with the Tribunal by destroying the fire elementals in Charred Vale. When destroyed, the fire elementals leave Incendrites. Return these to me and be rewarded.
6393-accept.title: Elemental War

6393-complete.name: Tsunaman
6393-complete.text: The water spirits within me bubble with the excitement. $N, you have given me a glorious victory to report to the Tribunal of the Tides.
6393-complete.title: Elemental War

6393-progress.name: Tsunaman
6393-progress.text: The Tribunal of the Tides grows impatient. They seek to end this war that has raged across all dimensions for eons. My brethren are anxious to hear news of the glorious victory over the hated fire elementals. Have you the Incendrites that I require?
6393-progress.title: Elemental War

6421-accept.name: Mor'rogal
6421-accept.text:
Something is amiss here in Stonetalon. Can you feel the tension in the air, $N?

Southeast of here lies a deep cave in Boulderslide Ravine. The kobolds there are frantically mining a rare crystal called Resonite. I need you to bring back some ore samples so that I can understand what's happening in that cave.  I also need you to investigate the depth of that cave.

Go young $c, it's imperative I know what evil lurks under these mountains.
6421-accept.title: Boulderslide Ravine

6421-complete.name: Mor'rogal
6421-complete.text:
Ah... Yes! That's it; the Resonite crystals have a trace of Earthen magic. The kobolds must have dug deep uncovering an Earthen.

Legend states that the Earthen are creatures created by the Titans.  They were used to create the land our feet walk on. This most definitely is a threat that cannot be ignored.

<Mor'rogal shakes his head.>

Perhaps I can enchant these ore samples to use against this kobold plot.
6421-complete.title: Boulderslide Ravine

6421-progress.name: Mor'rogal
6421-progress.text: What news have you discovered from Boulderslide Ravine? I recall some legend that deals with Resonite... I just cannot place my hoof on it. Perhaps knowing what lies at the bottom of the cave will illuminate their devious intentions.
6421-progress.title: Boulderslide Ravine

6481-accept.name: Mor'rogal
6481-accept.text:
You have uncovered a dark threat to the land, $c. The Resonite cask you have found in that cave houses a slumbering Earthen by the name of Goggeroc.

I have changed the mixture of the Resonite crystals that you gathered with my shamanistic powers. Take the enchanted Resonite crystal and smash open the Resonite cask, which houses the Earthen.

When awakened, Goggeroc will be weakened... Slay him, $N!
6481-accept.title: Earthen Arise

6481-complete.name: Mor'rogal
6481-complete.text:
You bear good news, $c! I fear the possibilities of what an Earthen would mean to Kalimdor.

Slaying Goggeroc was a task for no one less than a hero. You have done well; all of Stonetalon and Kalimdor are indebted to you, noble $c.

Accept this as your reward most honored one.
6481-complete.title: Earthen Arise

6481-progress.name: Mor'rogal
6481-progress.text: I fear if we do not dispose of this threat immediately, all of Stonetalon will be lost. The might of an Earthen can not be matched by any means. When awakened, Goggeroc will be weak from his long slumber, this will be the opportunity that you must take advantage of... go now $N!
6481-progress.title: Earthen Arise

6548-accept.name: Makaba Flathoof
6548-accept.text:
The Grimtotem Clan raided my village and killed most everyone. I killed all I could, but barely escaped with my life.

$N, all I wish now is that more of them are dead. You will find them just to the west of here.
6548-accept.title: Avenge My Village

6548-complete.name: Makaba Flathoof
6548-complete.text: $N, I thank you... but I will never forget what the Grimtotem have done to my village.
6548-complete.title: Avenge My Village

6562-accept.name: Tsunaman
6562-accept.text: Je'neu Sancrea is in need of aid. He is at the Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale. The Night elf forest is to the north of the Stonetalon mountains. You can reach it by traveling through Windshear Crag or by heading north through Barrens. Zoram Strand is far to the west of the forest. Be careful, $N. There are forces there that will not take to your presence kindly.
6562-accept.title: Trouble in the Deeps

6629-accept.name: Makaba Flathoof
6629-accept.text:
$N, you've done a fine job killing Grimtotem. If you dare, Grundig Darkcloud and his personal band of brutes is by far the worst of the lot. He was the one who led the brutal attack on my village.

You will find him in Grimtotem Post a bit further up the path to the west. Kill him, and I will be forever grateful.
6629-accept.title: Kill Grundig Darkcloud

6629-complete.name: Makaba Flathoof
6629-complete.text: Grundig Darkcloud is dead! $N, I will always be grateful for what you've done here today.
6629-complete.title: Kill Grundig Darkcloud

6981-accept.name: Unknown
6981-accept.text:
The shard is a brilliant green, and although solid, what looks like smoke swirls just below the surface. You can't help staring into the depths of the crystal; at the same time, you know there is something very disturbing about it.

Maybe you should see if anyone in Ratchet can tell you more about this strange shard.
6981-accept.title: The Glowing Shard

6981-complete.name: Falla Sagewind
6981-complete.text: Oh... I have never seen anything like this...
6981-complete.title: The Glowing Shard

6981-progress.name: Falla Sagewind
6981-progress.text: Hello, $r. What can I do for you?
6981-progress.title: The Glowing Shard

855-complete.name: Regthar Deathgate
855-complete.text:
Nicely done.  I'm sure you've struck fear into the surviving centaurs, $N.  If they have sense, they'll now calm themselves and stop their advances.

But I don't think they will, and that is unfortunate.

Unfortunate...for them.
855-complete.title: Centaur Bracers

862-accept.name: Grub
862-accept.text:
A $c like you must get pretty hungry out here in The Barrens. Me, I'm starving all day long.

Tell you what, I'll fix you up a nice stew. Just need a few dig rats.

Seems those filthy dwarves at Bael Modan are overrun with everyone's favorite feast. Now head on down south to Bael Modan and bring me back some dig rats.

You can't call yourself a seasoned adventurer until you've spent some time killing rats! Haw!
862-accept.title: Dig Rat Stew

86576-progress.name: Mor'rogal
86576-progress.text: I have important matters to consider, $c. Be quick.
86576-progress.title: Bloodfury Trinkets

877-complete.name: Tonga Runetotem
877-complete.text:
Your findings are amazing!  The seeds I gave you were dried, and dead.  Whatever rests under these oases can create life from nothing!

We must study this more...
877-complete.title: The Stagnant Oasis

880-accept.name: Tonga Runetotem
880-accept.text:
Your findings are incredible, $N.  These oases hold properties that must come from an outside source.  Or perhaps an inside one.

I want to know how these fissures are affecting the beasts who drink from the oases' water.

Hunt oasis snapjaws at the Lushwater and Stagnant Oases.  Bring me their shells so I may examine them.
880-accept.title: Altered Beings

887-complete.name: Gazlowe
887-complete.text:
You did good, kid. A little more work like that, and it'll be one less thing I'll have to worry about. Hopefully they'll be convinced that they should relocate their operation elsewhere.

In the meantime, there is the small matter of getting back the goods they stole from me!
887-complete.title: Southsea Freebooters

888-accept.name: Gazlowe
888-accept.text:
While I'd like to recover all my goods, I'm sure that's not possible. Still, there's a few things that I absolutely must have!

As you see, my observatory is ready to go, but it needs the smaller of the two lenses. The first arrived by caravan from Durotar, but the second was bound by ship, and never arrived. Also, I never got my boot shipment from Drizzlik in Booty Bay!

Head down to the pirate camp and see if you can find them.
888-accept.title: Stolen Booty

890-accept.name: Gazlowe
890-accept.text:
I've been waiting forever for my last shipment of goods from Booty Bay! I'm pretty sure that it must have been stolen by the Freebooters, but just to make sure, will you go down to the dockside and ask Dizzywig if my goods were already put into my warehouse without my knowledge?

Here, take my ledger down to Dizzywig and have him double check my inventory records against his logs.
890-accept.title: The Missing Shipment

890-complete.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
890-complete.text:
Ah, Gazlowe sent you, did he? Just a moment, let me take a look here and check my own logs and make sure I didn't have Gazlowe's shipment sent to the wrong place.

Bet he's waiting for those boots from Drizzlek...
890-complete.title: The Missing Shipment

890-progress.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
890-progress.text: Wares to send on the next ship, $N?
890-progress.title: The Missing Shipment

892-accept.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
892-accept.text:
Everything looks square from my records, $N. Go on back and tell Gazlowe he's out of luck. I wouldn't be surprised if it was the pirates that nabbed his goodies.

Nothing else I can do for him. Oh... though you could tell him that I've got some things from Undermine for him, when he has the time to come pick them up.
892-accept.title: The Missing Shipment

892-complete.name: Gazlowe
892-complete.text:
No dice, eh? I guess it must have been the Freebooters then... Dizzywig's on the level, I'm sure he wouldn't cheat me like that. After all, he is on the payroll.

Looks like I've got some goods to get back, $N. What do you say?
892-complete.title: The Missing Shipment

892-progress.name: Gazlowe
892-progress.text: So, what did Dizzywig have to say?
892-progress.title: The Missing Shipment

893-accept.name: Tatternack Steelforge
893-accept.text:
The Razormane quilboars to the south, beyond the Field of Giants, have no skilled blacksmiths from what I am told, but they've apparently started to develop sturdier weapons. I'd like to get my hands on a few different types to learn their techniques if possible.

If you wish to help bring honor to the Horde, then bring me examples of their weapons. Find me a dagger from their stalkers, a wand from their seers, and a shield from their warfrenzy. That should do nicely!
893-accept.title: Weapons of Choice

895-complete.name: Gazlowe
895-complete.text:
Ahhhh! That sort of business. You know, I saw the Heedless once on the open seas. Fearsome ship, or was that boat... those sailors are so particular!

Anyways, watching her glide across the water was quite a sight to see. I'm glad her infamous captain will trouble my ships no longer.
895-complete.title: WANTED: Baron Longshore

895-progress.name: Gazlowe
895-progress.text: What's happening? Something I can help you with? Goods to ship, perhaps an engineering job?
895-progress.title: WANTED: Baron Longshore

898-accept.name: Gilthares Firebough
898-accept.text:
Finally! Someone to rescue me!

I can't believe you got past the guards. These zealots from Theramore are out of their minds. They sank our ship and imprisoned me, the only survivor. I was called an enemy and threat to the Alliance.

Me! A threat to their great sham of an Alliance? I was a deckhand on a moonshine transport between Ratchet and Booty Bay.

Enough talk. Help me get back to Ratchet will you? Let me know when you're ready and we'll make our break.
898-accept.title: Free From the Hold

898-complete.name: Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun
898-complete.text:
And to think, we thought Firebough was long dead!

Your heroics have earned you a place of honor with the Thalo'dan Privateers, $N.
898-complete.title: Free From the Hold

899-complete.name: Mankrik
899-complete.text:
$C, you take my task seriously, and for that I thank you.

Although my desire for revenge remains, I can at least smile seeing that the quilboars have felt pain themselves.
899-complete.title: Consumed by Hatred

899-progress.name: Mankrik
899-progress.text: The quilboar will pay for this, $N. I swear it.
899-progress.title: Consumed by Hatred

959-complete.name: Crane Operator Bigglefuzz
959-complete.text:
Superb! And just as I was about to lose my job too! I will see to it that Gazlowe gets this gift immediately.

Thank you, $N. Nicely done, I say!
959-complete.title: Trouble at the Docks

959-progress.name: Crane Operator Bigglefuzz
959-progress.text:
The dockmaster has been on my case ever since Mad Magglish made off with that 99-year-old port. I guess that bottle was intended as a gift for Gazlowe from none other than Baron Revilgaz himself.

If you're brave enough and patient enough to seek out Mad Magglish and get that port back, I'll see to it you get a nice reward.
959-progress.title: Trouble at the Docks

962-accept.name: Dots
962-accept.text:
The Royal Apothecary Society, based in the great Undercity of Lordaeron, has sent me here for a very specific service, $N. Perhaps you wish to aid me, and in turn The Dark Lady in our efforts to advance the Forsaken.

Recently I studied a rare specimen of flora named Serpentbloom. I believe in greater quantities this herb has great potential.

Unfortunately Serpentbloom can only be found in the darkest recesses of the Wailing Caverns, a dangerous cave system located in the Barrens.
962-accept.title: Serpentbloom

962-complete.name: Apothecary Zamah
962-complete.text: Ah, splendid specimens. You have done well, $N.
962-complete.title: Serpentbloom

962-progress.name: Apothecary Zamah
962-progress.text: I am eager to see if you can gather enough Serpentbloom from the Wailing Caverns. I've sent many to do my bidding but none have returned.
962-progress.title: Serpentbloom
